title_en: Good News (8/20): A New Vaccine Against Malaria
note_en: 一旦…就… means "once…" or "if ever…", describing a condition that immediately triggers a result: 一旦被蚊子传染，很小的孩子就可能很快发展成重症 "once infected by a mosquito, very young children can quickly become seriously ill." 一旦 usually signals something undesirable or decisive, and 就 goes after the subject of the second clause, not at its start.
